description: UNHAS: airport locations is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by UN Humanitarian Air Service. UNHAS airport data has no new UNHAS operations established, the data may have only marginal changes of few new airfields. The data was confirmed and remains relevant. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
